activities.description:
Ekiden is an institutional-grade, orderbook-based hybrid derivatives exchange built natively for the Canton Network ecosystem. Designed to meet the stringent demands of high-frequency traders and financial institutions, the platform combines the speed of off-chain matching with the transparency of delayed on-chain settlement. This unique rollup-like architecture empowers users to execute complex trading strategies with deep liquidity while eliminating traditional counterparty risks.

Functioning as a seamless decentralized trading terminal, the ecosystem bridges the gap between centralized execution and decentralized finance. The application provides professionals with robust API connectivity, cross-chain access, and advanced market structures. Recently approved as a Featured App on Canton, the project delivers a secure, compliant, and highly efficient environment for the next generation of tokenized asset trading.
activities.short_description: Ekiden is an institutional hybrid derivatives exchange on the Canton Network.

activities.description:
Vangrid is a decentralized physical infrastructure network (DePIN) and spatial intelligence platform built for the era of Physical AI. The protocol transforms billions of ordinary smartphones into a distributed, privacy-first capture network, enabling users to generate continuously updated, high-fidelity 3D spatial data simply by mapping real-world locations. This crowdsourced approach eliminates the need for expensive, specialized hardware or fleets of mapping vehicles.

By incentivizing everyday users to digitize dynamic human environments, Vangrid provides verifiable ground-truth data for advanced use cases, including robotics, autonomous systems, and defense applications. The platform acts as a shared sensing layer for machines, democratizing access to spatial intelligence and allowing enterprise clients to navigate and interact with the physical world in real time.
activities.short_description: Decentralized DePIN spatial intelligence network for Physical AI and robotics.
